name: Controller
description: Natural or legal person which determines the purposes and means of processing

name: Processor
description: Natural or legal person which processes personal data on behalf of the controller

name: Data Protection Officer
description: Designated officer overseeing data protection compliance

name: Supervisory Authority
description: Independent public authority established by a Member State

name: Recipient
description: Natural or legal person to which personal data are disclosed

name: Third Party
description: Person other than data subject, controller, processor, or authorized persons

name: Representative
description: Person designated to represent controller/processor in EU

name: Provider
description: Person that develops an AI system or has one developed and places it on the market

name: Deployer
description: Person using an AI system under its authority

name: Importer
description: Person located in EU placing AI system from third country on market

name: Distributor
description: Person in supply chain making AI system available, other than provider/importer

name: Product Manufacturer
description: Manufacturer placing AI system with their product under their name

name: Authorised Representative
description: Person in EU with written mandate from provider

name: Notified Body
description: Conformity assessment body designated under AI Act

name: Market Surveillance Authority
description: National authority carrying out market surveillance

name: AI Office
description: Commission body supporting AI Act implementation

name: Affected Person
description: Person subject to or affected by an AI system
